queries.alt:
with a as (
select * from public.alternative_pick_selection_state
where bundle_id='pregame_alternative_pick_methodology_v2' and checkpoint='frozen_pregame' and selection_status='selected' and slate_date between '2026-07-24' and '2026-09-03'
), h as materialized (
select x from public.published_pipeline_artifacts p cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(p.payload) x
where p.artifact_key='picks_history' and x->>'date' between '2026-07-24' and '2026-09-03'
)
select a.slate_date,a.pitcher,a.side,a.model_k_line,a.official_odds,a.official_verdict,a.official_book,a.lane,a.selector_fingerprint,a.provider_posture,
a.frozen_at,a.game_time,a.lock_status,a.minutes_until_start,
(a.frozen_at<a.game_time and a.locked_at=a.frozen_at) as prestart_valid,
(l.consumed_at is not null and l.source_artifact_sha256=a.lock_artifact_sha256 and l.source_artifact_path=a.lock_source_artifact_path and l.locked_k_line=a.model_k_line and l.locked_odds=a.official_odds and l.locked_at=a.locked_at) as lock_valid,
(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('result',x->>'result','actual_ks',x->'actual_ks','pnl',x->'pnl','odds',x->'odds','locked_odds',x->'locked_odds','k_line',x->'k_line','locked_k_line',x->'locked_k_line','game_time',x->>'game_time')) from h where x->>'date'=a.slate_date::text and x->>'pitcher'=a.pitcher and lower(x->>'side')=lower(a.side)) as history_matches
from a left join public.operational_pick_locks l on l.dedupe_key=a.lock_dedupe_key order by a.slate_date,a.pitcher
queries.operations:
select jsonb_build_object(
'observed_at',now(),
'artifacts',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('key',artifact_key,'generated_at',generated_at,'published_at',published_at,'source_run_id',source_run_id,'sha256',payload_sha256)) from public.published_pipeline_artifacts where artifact_key in ('today','params','performance','preview_lines','dated_slate:2026-09-03')),
'params',(select payload from public.published_pipeline_artifacts where artifact_key='params'),
'performance',(select payload from public.published_pipeline_artifacts where artifact_key='performance'),
'locks_sep3',(select jsonb_build_object('rows',count(*),'unconsumed',count(*) filter(where consumed_at is null),'duplicate_keys',count(*)-count(distinct dedupe_key)) from public.operational_pick_locks where slate_date='2026-09-03'),
'database_bytes',pg_database_size(current_database()),
'snapshot_relation_bytes',pg_total_relation_size('public.market_snapshots'),
'webhook_relation_bytes',pg_total_relation_size('public.propline_webhook_deliveries')
) as evidence;
